svg.title: The jPipe tool suite with the code base on the CI server
svg.desc: A figure labelled developer faces a dashed boundary marked your computer, containing an editor labelled jPipe IDE, a gold box of cogs labelled jPipe compiler, a dot json file card, and a rack labelled jPipe runner. An arrow carries the json across into a taller dashed boundary marked CI/CD server, which holds a rack labelled jPipe runner above a box labelled code base with source lines and a branch graph. An arrow runs down from the remote runner to the code base. Two figures labelled other developers, below, send a short arrow up into the code base.
